answer: An identity buys its seat with Registered mapmaker projection docket sworn before the guild court; the price of the seat is 3-year field service, 144 supervised computations, engraving exam, annual. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 529 fakes pay 529 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. What the pearl proves is the identity, what the summit proves is the cost, and what the nadir proves is the patience. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
